setup: Ysmay, Quicksilver vow level 2; level 1 chosen Strike from the Flank and Quick Recovery (4 of 4); level 2 chosen Bleeding Cut (3 of 4); 10 AP, 20 anima, one Token of the Vow; rite made through the Ritual admin (10 anima, one Token of the Vow)

runs.label: the picks before
runs.output:
Quicksilver, vow level 2.
Level 1: 4 of 4.
  - Feint and Vanish, 2 pts. (costs more than is left) One step in, two steps gone.
      Timing limit, met 5 times in 10
  - Light on Your Feet, 4 pts. (costs more than is left) Always a step further than they think.
      no limits
  * Quick Recovery, 2 pts. Chosen. You are back on your feet before they turn.
      Timing limit, met 5 times in 10
  * Strike from the Flank, 2 pts. Chosen. Your cut lands harder on someone already busy with an ally.
      Target limit, met 5 times in 10
Level 2: 3 of 4.
  * Bleeding Cut, 3 pts. Chosen. A shallow cut that keeps opening.
      Cost limit, price less 1
  - Read the Feint, 1 pt. You see the second blade coming.
      no limits
  - Through the Gap, 4 pts. (costs more than is left) Where the shield is not.
      no limits
Level 3: opens at vow level 3.
  - Hold the Line, 2 pts. (opens at vow level 3) A wall where there was a door.
      no limits
  - Iron Resolve, 3 pts. (opens at vow level 3) The blow lands and you stay.
      no limits
  - The Last Word, 4 pts. (opens at vow level 3) Whoever speaks last is standing.
      no limits

runs.label: different level
runs.command: vow reswear Quick Recovery=Read the Feint
runs.output: Read the Feint is a level 2 pick and Quick Recovery is level 1; a pick changes only for one of the same level.

runs.label: over budget
runs.command: vow reswear Quick Recovery=Light on Your Feet
runs.output: Light on Your Feet costs 4; giving up Quick Recovery leaves 2 of the 4 points for level 1 picks.

runs.label: pick not chosen
runs.command: vow reswear Light on Your Feet=Feint and Vanish
runs.output: You have not chosen a pick named Light on Your Feet.

runs.label: short of action points
runs.command: vow reswear Quick Recovery=Feint and Vanish
runs.output: The rite takes 3 action points, and you have 2.

runs.label: in an encounter
runs.command: vow reswear Quick Recovery=Feint and Vanish
runs.output: You cannot re-swear a vow pick during a fight.

runs.label: success, lower case old name
runs.command: vow reswear quick recovery=Feint and Vanish
runs.output: You perform Rite of Re-swearing. You give up Quick Recovery and take Feint and Vanish. Level 1: 4 of 4. 3 AP spent.
